evidence.excerpt: Mamužić has provided consulting to two domestic manufacturers of industrial control panels on EMC filter selection and IEC 61800-3 pre-compliance testing procedures. She has also participated in a short-term industry contract with a regional drive assembler to audit an existing product line for Category C2 compliance.
